code-u4-l1-b.prompt: What feature makes Porta cipher decryption identical to its encryption?

code-u4-l1-b.prompt: How are coordinates handled during the decoding process of a Nihilist cipher?

Convert the coordinate into a single row-column index using a checkerboard.

code-u8-l1-b.prompt: What defines a complete columnar transposition cipher according to the rules?

code-u8-l1-b.prompt: What is the primary purpose of a homophonic substitution system?

therm-u6-l1-b.prompt: Which type of path on a pressure-volume graph represents a constant-volume process?

A horizontal path.

A curved exponential path.

Temperature multiplied by pressure.

therm-u6-l1-b.prompt: What happens during an adiabatic expansion of an ideal gas?

The temperature of the gas remains strictly constant.

The total conservation of energy within a closed system.

The rate at which friction decreases system temperature.

therm-u8-l1-b.prompt: Why can a refrigerator cool its interior while warming the surrounding room?

It operates as a reversible process with zero entropy production.
The total entropy of the combined system decreases over time.
Heat spontaneously flows from colder objects to hotter objects.

therm-u8-l1-b.prompt: What characterizes a reversible thermodynamic process?

therm-u8-l1-b.prompt: Which limitation applies to any cyclic heat engine operating between two reservoirs?
